name: Realizable Ample Classes Are Strictly Dismantlable Ample
scope: Finite nonempty binary classes and their one-inclusion graphs.
statement: Every realizable ample class has a corner peeling, while $E_{26}$ is dismantlable ample and nonrealizable.
proof: A realizable ample class is a realizable lopsided COM; realizable COMs admit corner peelings, and ample corners are single vertices. The exact four-section ratio cycle proves that $E_{26}$ is nonrealizable, while its peripheral recursion gives a peeling.
